g.text: DB ownership is shown inside each service. All eight schemas can share a single local MySQL instance; there are no normal cross-service SQL joins.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,14%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Key internal paths: Reservation -> Train/Schedule/PNR; Chatbot -> authorized live APIs; protected services -> Auth session/account validation.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,14%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Booking events: Reservation outbox -> RabbitMQ (or internal HTTP) -> Notification inbox -> SMTP. Account mail: Auth -> SMTP.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,14%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: External integration names identify their service relationships. No Redis, Docker or WSL is required; secrets remain in private environment configuration.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px;fill: rgb(34%,40%,49%); stroke:none;

g.text: Source: backend/README.md, service configuration and current API clients. Arrows show selected request/event directions; return traffic and every internal endpoint are omitted.
